reviewRemediation.source: post-release Codex review (gpt-6-astra, low) of git diff v0.6.5..v0.6.6 — 3 findings, verified by an Opus agent: #105 CONFIRMED (zip written outside a not-yet-created root), #106 CONFIRMED for mutate() / REFUTED for tier(), #107 CONFIRMED including the socket being recreated after shutdown cleanup

fixed.#105: deepestRealPath keeps the non-existent remainder; containment re-checked after mkdir of root/staging/output parent

reviewRemediation.regressionEvidence: all three new tests confirmed failing on the pre-fix code.

priorEvidence: Receipts for 0.5.0–0.6.5 are archived as docs/verification/merge-gate-pre-<version>.json; their live proofs (tier migration, daemon takeover, re-acquisition, warm start) are not repeated here.

liveInjectionYield.observedOn: the user's real data root running v0.6.0
liveInjectionYield.note: The v0.6.0 receipt recorded liveInjectionYield as NOT_PROVEN and said it would be checked after release. It was, and real sessions injected memory. This is cited as prior live evidence about v0.6.0, not as an observation of these gates: nothing in this run touched the real root, and the isolation check proves it did not. It is also not evidence that 0.6.2 still injects, since the tier code it depends on changed in between.

releaseConclusion: Every gate in docs/VERIFICATION.md §2/§4 passes on the clean v0.6.7 candidate efcbd3bc on its first attempt: real-root snapshot (139 files), typecheck, reproducible build, 119 files / 1251 Vitest tests, 215 mjs tests, installer, marketplace, packaged runtime (memex-0.6.7.tgz, 332 files, 9 MCP tools), lifecycle 9/9, 151 Workspace unit tests, 22 browser probes with 0 runtime errors, isolated plugin validation, benchmark contract, pack dry-run and the closing real-root compare (139 files identical). #105–#107 are fixed with regression tests that fail on 0.6.6.
